题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："Responsibly" is close in meaning to "______".
A. carelessly
B. quickly
C. loudly
D. carefully and sensibly
考点：用法
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：The opposite of "responsibly" is "______".
A. unresponsibly
B. irresponsibly
C. disresponsibly
D. responsively
考点：词性转换
题目.答案:
【1】A（负责任地）
讲解：responsibly 负责任地。
【2】B（responsibly）
讲解：修饰动词 act 用副词。
【3】responsible
讲解：名词前面用形容词。
【4】responsible → responsibly
讲解：修饰动词 drives 用副词。
【5】responsibility
讲解：my 后面要名词。
【6】D（carefully and sensibly）
讲解：responsibly 负责任地。
【7】B（irresponsibly）
讲解：否定前缀用 ir-。
